sources.note: The only full phonology of Chiru; Wikipedia cites its pp. 91-92 for a two-tone (high/low) register system, so a suprasegmentals section exists and would hold any stress statement. Chapter PDFs are on Shodhganga (06_chapter is the likely phonology chapter) but the bitstream server (port 8443) was down when we checked the sources.
